title: Senior Solutions Scientist
text:
Position Overview 

We seek a passionate full-time technical professional to help drive our customers' success using Matlantis™, our flexible and scalable SaaS platform. Join a team dedicated to delivering outstanding customer experience. 

With the mission of "accelerating materials discovery for a sustainable future", Matlantis Inc. provides Matlantis™, a versatile calculation engine, to help customers accelerate the development of new materials and elucidate their mechanisms. 

Matlantis Inc. offers Matlantis™ as SaaS. We sell software licenses and help our customers achieve meaningful results using Matlantis™. We also carry out simulation projects on customers' behalf, delivering answers to their R&D questions on a defined scope and schedule. We provide support for how to use Matlantis™ and conduct professional technical explanations, such as discussions on modeling and simulation methods and case validations. Moreover, we support promoting customers' digital transformation (DX). 

Since starting our business in July 2021, we have received interest from customers in various industries. We are addressing cutting-edge challenges in all aspects, including target materials, phenomena, and computational methods. 

We look forward to applications from enthusiastic individuals who want to learn and advance their work in this challenging environment. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

Establishing a presence in the industry: Participate in conferences and exhibitions, gain leads through presentations, showcase technical capabilities, and promote building personal networks. 

Pre-sales activities/clarifying technical issues for potential customers: Provide technical explanations of the product to potential customers. Through effective dialogue, customers' 

problems are identified, and hypotheses for solving them are developed. 

Leading customer success meetings: Understand customers' challenges and propose and discuss the most effective simulation technologies and workflows tailored to their needs. 

Leading customer-funded simulation projects: Own each project from scoping to final report. Define the scope, schedule, and deliverables with the customer, build the models and run the calculations on Matlantis™, and deliver simulation-based answers to the customer's R&D questions with technical interpretation and recommendations for next steps. Manage project progress and communicate it to the customer and internal stakeholders.

Collaboration with the product development team: Act as a bridge to accurately convey customer feedback to the product development team and reflect it in product improvements. Go 

beyond simple information sharing by understanding and communicating underlying needs. 

Research and implementation of computational chemistry methods: For various materials, you will research and implement physical and chemical simulation methods (such as molecular 

dynamics, Monte Carlo, reaction pathway analysis, metadynamics, etc.). You will create case studies for conference presentations, paper submissions, customer support, and marketing purposes and appropriately publish these. You will lead joint research with research institutions such as universities. Other duties and responsibilities are assigned as needed. 

Minimum Qualifications 

Knowledge equivalent to a postgraduate physics, chemistry, or materials science degree. 

Deep experience/knowledge in a specific materials field. Programming skills using Python. 

Fulfill one or more of the following:1) Experience in computational chemistry, such as deep knowledge or practical use of simulation techniques like quantum chemistry calculations, molecular dynamics, classical force field calculation methods, Monte Carlo methods, reaction pathway search calculations, crystal structure search calculations, etc. 2)Data analysis skills using machine learning and statistical analysis tools (e.g., NumPy, pandas, scikit learn) 

Preferred Qualifications 

Research and development and paper writing experience related to atomistic simulations, cheminformatics or materials informatics. Knowledge and proficiency in computational chemistry software and auxiliary tools. 

Experience using Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE), LAMMPS, GAUSSIAN, VASP, etc. 

Experience tracking trends in the latest papers and conducting replication studies. 

Experience delivering simulation projects to external customers or collaborators on a defined scope and schedule, from proposal through final report. 

Willingness to constantly learn new domain knowledge and 

actively engage in discussions. Communication skills and teamwork mindset to facilitate smooth 

collaboration with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners. Enthusiasm for market expansion and development. Skills for discussing with customers in Japanese, as well as reading and writing Japanese documents. Proven experience in managing and leading teams, including mentoring, performance management, and fostering a collaborative work environment. 

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $180,000 per year. The final offer will be based on the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications. The same range applies to candidates anywhere in the United States. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on company and individual performance.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; paid time off and paid holidays.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Matlantis, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us @Matlantis LinkedIn profile page.
